enabled.name: Enable flank vision
enabled.hint: Master switch for every overlay this module draws. Toggle with Alt+F.

flankedMarkers.name: Mark flanked tokens
flankedMarkers.hint: Outline every token on the scene that is currently flanked.

selectedStatus.name: Selected token status
selectedStatus.hint: For your selected token: outline the enemies it flanks (with a line to the ally making it work) and outline the token itself when it is being flanked.

dragPreview.name: Preview while dragging
dragPreview.hint: While dragging a token, show the flanking situation it would land in rather than the one it left.

placementDots.name: Show flanking positions
placementDots.hint: Dot every square your selected token could move to in order to flank an enemy with an ally already in place. The expensive one.

wallsBlock.name: Walls break flanking
wallsBlock.hint: House rule: require a clear line between the two flankers. Off by default, since the rules do not ask for one.

searchRadius.name: Position search radius
searchRadius.hint: Squares. Enemies further away than this are ignored when looking for flanking positions.

maxSquares.name: Position limit
maxSquares.hint: Stop after this many flanking positions, so a crowded scene cannot stall the canvas.

notifications.unsupportedGrid: PF2e Flank Vision only understands square grids, so its overlays are off on this scene.
